name: Propitiation
overview: The concept of propitiation in Scripture reveals God's provision for removing the barrier of sin between Himself and humanity through the sacrificial death of Jesus Christ. Romans 3:25 explains that Jesus was set forth as a propitiation by faith in His blood, demonstrating God's righteousness while granting remission of sins. This act of propitiation brings peace and reconciliation with God, as believers are justified by faith (Romans 5:1) and reconciled even while once enemies (Romans 5:10). The urgency of turning to God in repentance and faith is underscored by the contrast between those who believe and receive eternal life and those who remain under God's wrath (John 3:16, 3:36; Luke 18:13).
